findings.passage: Ohioans deserve elections they can trust," Workman said. "Requiring photo ID to vote is a simple, widely supported safeguard. Enshrining it in our Constitution ensures this protection stays in place for the long term, no matter who is in power, protecting election security for generations to come.
findings.note: Statement in her House news release on the ballot language for State Issue 3 (SJR 10), which would put the photo ID requirement for in-person voting into the Ohio Constitution.

findings.passage: This resolution is just commonsense and reinforces public trust, It's imperative we codify these requirements through the Ohio Constitution so that future generations can feel secure when taking part in the election process.
